one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: (1) the $2.0B unit offering settles about 2026-10-16 (src 34): 50M share-equivalents plus 100M Series C warrants at $69.46; holders hedging the warrants can add selling pressure, and the stock already fell 9.2% today on the deal. (2) Q3-2026 results: no date announced as of 2026-10-14; Q3-2025 was reported on 2025-11-05, so early November (inside the window) is likely. It is the first quarter with SkyWater consolidated, against the $450-460M FY26 guide (src 8); IonQ beat its own guidance in Q1 and Q2. (3) Elisity could close in Q4 (src 36; outside date 2027-01-07, src 35); at prices below $33.07 it issues 34.8M shares, which is already known. No directional edge, so the ladder is a lognormal with median $31.2 (slightly below spot for vol drag and the warrant-hedging overhang) and ~27% one-month log-vol (92%/3.5 plus an earnings bump). Unchanged in substance from round 1.

bear.story: Superion 256 deliveries slip or ship without convincing full-system fidelity. The 2027 10,000-qubit step is visibly off track while IBM, Quantinuum and neutral-atom teams publish logical-qubit gains. The stock de-rates to cash + units ($9.6 after warrants) plus a small option, about $13. Revenue still grows through SkyWater, Elisity and space/networking, but the market stops paying for the computing roadmap.

base.story: FY26 lands near $450-460M and FY27 shows full-year SkyWater plus organic growth; Superion 256 starts deliveries and Stage C verification proceeds; the 10,000-qubit chip is guided later than 2027. The premium over fundamental value (~$12.9) narrows but does not close; the new 100M Series C warrants and Elisity shares add supply. Vol drag pulls the median below spot.

bull.story: Superion 256 hits spec and a credible 10,000-qubit/800-logical demonstration lands in 2027, ahead of IBM's 2029 Starling; large government and enterprise system orders follow and quantum stocks re-rate toward their highs. The Series C warrants at $69.46 cap the upside above that level.

thesis_break_reason: At $11.50 (537.5M share-equivalents plus a ~$170M warrant claim) the market would value computing at ~$1.1B over net cash and operating units ($5.38B, $9.6/share after warrants). That is below what IonQ paid for Oxford Ionics and Lightsynq ($1.9B), i.e. the roadmap priced as close to failed. Fundamental triggers: Superion 256 deliveries slipping out of 2027 or shipping without full-system fidelity data, the 10,000-qubit chip formally pushed past 2029, loss of DARPA QBI Stage C standing, or cash falling below ~$2.5B through cash M&A. Ordinary sector swings (30-39% monthly drawdowns this year) should not take it there on their own.

reasoning: Industry lane, round 2. The supervisor's corrections changed the bridge, not the story. (1) Facts I missed, now confirmed at the filings: the 2026-10-14 424B5 (20.5M shares + 29.5M pre-funded warrants with 100M Series C warrants @ $69.46 to 2033-10-16, net ~$1,988.5M, 408.9M shares outstanding on 10-13) and the Elisity 8-K ($1,150M in stock, $33.07-$49.61 collar, $150M earnout, $100M retention RSUs, outside date 2027-01-07). Horizon share-equivalents go from 445M to 537.5M and horizon net cash from $1.40B to $3.22B (including SkyWater's residual $100.6M of debt and leases and ~$140M/yr of interest income). (2) Quantinuum's mark uses its filed 263.31M shares and today's $33.46 (EV ~$6.83B). (3) SkyWater is now valued on foundry peers (TSEM, GFS) at 20x FY25 adj. EBITDA ($1.06B) instead of the trade-press unaffected premium. (4) New in-lane evidence: Superion 256 was unveiled with SkyWater-made QPUs, but no full-system fidelity is published and deliveries are 2027 (eWeek), so I cut P(10,000-qubit on time | 256) from 0.40 to 0.35. Elisity's revenue is undisclosed and it had raised only >$72M (Insight Partners), so I value it at ~55% of the stock paid. (5) Methods: rNPV $10.49, TAM $11.01, floor+option $11.62, QNT mark $19.33, SOTP at cost $12.85 -> $12.89 (was $15.08). The offering at $40/unit added cash per share, but Elisity, the Series C warrants and post-horizon SBC took more away. (6) Ladder: mixture bear $13/0.35, base $23/0.45, bull $50/0.20 (within-scenario log-vol 0.38-0.45) -> median ~$20.9, mean ~$27.2, P(>= $32) 0.26. That is lower than round 1 (median ~$22) because of lower fair value and more supply, but well above fair value because sector sentiment can persist. Where I differ from the supervisor: units at $2.16B (not $2.45B) because I value Elisity and the small units further below cost, and I put a 0.85 ratio on the QNT mark. Limits: sec.gov refused curl, so filings were read with WebFetch; McKinsey's page returned 503 earlier (PostQuantum summary used); no Q3 date announcement was found.

model_inputs.structure_note: The standard DCF/multiple structure cannot describe IonQ: GAAP EBIT is about -400% of revenue, FCFF stays negative through FY2029 and value rests on a technology outcome after the horizon. dcf_weight and multiple weights are 0 and value is carried in five custom legs. Years are for reference: FY26 is the guide; FY27 adds full-year SkyWater (~$600M external, H1-26 $317.1M annualised less intercompany) to ~50% standalone growth (~$1.03B). net_debt and net_debt_horizon are stated directly from the bridge (pro forma $2.0B + offering - SkyWater debt - burn).
model_inputs.gap_note: fair_value.value is the weighted mean of the custom legs (same weights as fair_value.methods). The base scenario carries custom_pct +0.785 because my 12-month base-case price ($23) includes a persisting sentiment premium over fundamental value ($12.89). My ladder (median ~$20.9) comes from my own scenario mixture, not the engine's.
